item.title: Rhian Ramos and Sam Verzosa's relationship timeline
item.description: Kinumpirma ni Sang'gre actress Rhian Ramos na hiwalay na sila ng four-year partner na si Sam Verzosa. Sa panayam niya sa Fast Talk With Boy Abunda nitong Biyernes, March 6, sinabi ni Rhian na naghiwalay sila ni Sam noon pang October 2025, at kapwa nasa tahimik na kalagayan ngayon. "Yes, we've broken up already. We're not in a romantic relationship anymore. And, I think, it's only now that I feel comfortable saying that because he confirmed it already, also in an interview, and I read about it. "
